-- Helper lemma: inserting into a sorted list keeps it sorted
def ins_sorted (a : Nat) (xs : Lst Nat) (h : Sorted xs) : Sorted (ins a xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      apply Sorted.one
  | cons x xs' =>
      cases h with
      | one b =>
          simp [Lst.ins]
          split
          case inl =>
            apply Sorted.two
            . apply Nat.le_refl
            . apply Sorted.one
          case inr =>
            apply Sorted.two
            . apply Nat.le_refl
            . apply Sorted.one
      | two b c ys hbc hsorted =>
          simp [Lst.ins]
          split
          case inl =>
            apply Sorted.two
            . apply Nat.le_refl
            . apply Sorted.two
              . assumption
              . assumption
          case inr =>
            apply Sorted.two
            . assumption
            . apply ins_sorted
              . assumption

-- Main theorem: insertion sort produces a sorted list
theorem isort_sorted (xs : Lst Nat) : Sorted (isort xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      apply Sorted.nil
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp [Lst.isort]
      apply ins_sorted
      . exact x
      . exact (isort xs)
      . exact ih
